meta.title: AZnet Theme UPN3 — Disposable WordPress QA
meta.description: Diagnostic disposable WP 6.9 PHP 8.1 run, exact version-pinned Theme. PHP errors printed.
meta.author: AZnet Theme

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
error_reporting( E_ALL );
ini_set( 'display_errors', '1' );
register_shutdown_function( function () {
    $last = error_get_last();
    if ( $last && in_array( $last['type'], [ E_ERROR, E_PARSE, E_CORE_ERROR, E_COMPILE_ERROR, E_USER_ERROR ], true ) ) {
        echo 'UPN3_SHUTDOWN_FATAL: ' . $last['message'] . ' at ' . $last['file'] . ':' . $last['line'] . "\n";
    }
} );
putenv( 'AZT_UPN3_DISPOSABLE=YES_DISPOSABLE' );
putenv( 'AZT_UPN3_EXPECT_BLOB=a3f118fb987aad11e7072475dfd80e1ac16c4d37' );
try {
    require WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/themes/aznet-theme/tests/wordpress/upn3-readonly-update-notice.php';
} catch ( Throwable $e ) {
    echo 'UPN3_CAUGHT_FAILURE: ' . get_class( $e ) . ': ' . $e->getMessage() . ' at ' . $e->getFile() . ':' . $e->getLine() . "\n";
    throw $e;
}
